title: Call and media awareness should hold proactive speech during external audio
body: Mana should notice active external audio/call sessions and avoid speaking proactive announcements over them. Add a native audio-session detector, wire it into the voice loop, and expose the proactive audio-awareness controls in Settings.
interface: Settings exposes HoldSpeechDuringAudio controls, and VoiceLoop accepts an external-audio busy predicate before proactive announcements.
why: Launcher-side OS awareness is required for self-sustaining background work that does not interrupt calls or media.
